Job Description
 Tremend is looking for an Implementation Consultant, who will configure and implement Salesforce-based solutions that support commercial lending and loan origination processes. Working closely with clients, project managers, and technical teams, you will translate business requirements into scalable, high-quality configurations aligned with platform best practices and delivery standards.
This role combines hands-on platform configuration with business analysis and stakeholder collaboration. You will play a key role in delivering technology solutions that help financial institutions modernize lending operations, improve efficiency, and enhance customer experiences.
The role is approximately 80% technical configuration and solution implementation and 20% business analysis and client collaboration.
 Responsibilities
Design, configure, and implement solutions based on client requirements and established delivery standards.
Perform advanced Salesforce configuration, including record-based configuration and Salesforce Flow development.
Analyze business requirements and translate them into scalable and efficient platform solutions.
Create and execute test scripts to validate configurations and ensure solution quality.
Collaborate closely with Project Managers, business stakeholders, and delivery partners to identify optimal implementation approaches.
Assess current and future-state business, application, technical, and data architectures, and contribute to implementation planning.
Demonstrate configured workflows and business processes to clients, clearly explaining functionality and operational impact.
Support client onboarding activities, including user access setup, data mapping, data migration support, and process documentation.
Troubleshoot configuration issues and recommend improvements to maximize platform value and adoption.
Participate in project workshops, requirements gathering sessions, and solution design discussions.
Maintain high-quality project documentation and implementation artifacts.
Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and help establish best practices across the delivery team.
 Skills And Experience
Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
Relevant professional experience, or an equivalent combination of education, experience, and demonstrated performance.
Experience working with Salesforce or similar enterprise CRM and workflow platforms.
Understanding of database design concepts, data structures, and workflow automation.
Experience analyzing, defining, and implementing business, technical, application, or solution architecture-based solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in client-facing environments.
Salesforce platform knowledge is preferred, including Salesforce Administrator and Developer certifications, or willingness to obtain certifications within six months of joining.
 Nice to Have
Existing Salesforce certifications.
Experience in commercial lending, loan origination, banking, or financial services.
Previous experience in consulting, implementation, or digital transformation projects.
Familiarity with GDPR requirements and EU data residency regulations in financial services environments.
Experience working directly with clients and facilitating workshops, training sessions, or solution demonstrations.
Knowledge of Salesforce Flow, platform configuration, and low-code automation capabilities.
 Additional Information
 Besides an exciting job in a tremendous team, here s what you can expect:
A fast-paced tech environment
Continuous growth & learning
Open feedback culture
Room for own initiative & ideas
Transparency about results & strategy
Recognition & reward for hard work
Working with a flexible schedule 
Medical subscription
Meal tickets
Extra vacation days - starting with 25 vacation days
Many others perks 
 Company Description
 Tremend is the newest global software engineering hub for Publicis Sapient. For over 20 years, the company has been infusing its advanced technical expertise into complex and innovative solutions that meet today s digital transformation needs and pave the way for a better and smarter future. By joining forces with Publicis Sapient we re accelerating the impact, providing a good mix of talented engineers, technology, continuous improvement, innovation, and R&D. Here, you ll have the opportunity to unleash your potential, powering up advanced software solutions for some of the world s most iconic brands. Embrace your passion for technology, creativity, and continuous improvement, and join us in making a difference through engineering.
